title: How to Increase Salon Rebooking Rate (From 33% to 58%) — Lutily Blog

facts.fact: The page states the industry average salon rebooking rate sits around 40%.
facts.quote: The industry average rebooking rate sits around **40%**.

facts.fact: The page cites a Boulevard industry report saying most salons lose about 30% of their client base every year from natural attrition.
facts.quote: most salons lose about **30% of their client base every year** just from natural attrition.

facts.fact: The page cites Zenoti saying acquiring a new client costs five to twenty-five times more than keeping one.
facts.quote: Acquiring a new client costs [five to twenty-five times more]

facts.fact: The page cites Phorest's retention data saying a returning client spends about 31% more per visit than a first-timer.
facts.quote: a returning client spends about **31% more per visit** than a first-timer

facts.fact: The page cites Savvy Salon Club's analysis saying tightening the average gap between visits from nine weeks to seven weeks produces a 29% increase in annual visits per client.
facts.unit: % increase in annual visits per client
facts.quote: produces a **29% increase in annual visits per client**

facts.fact: Per Boulevard's Client Retention Report as cited on the page, top-performing salons convert 70% of first visits into a second appointment.
facts.quote: Top-performing salons convert **70%** of first visits into a second appointment and **57%** into a third.

facts.fact: Per Boulevard's Client Retention Report as cited on the page, average salons convert 45% of first visits into a second appointment.
facts.quote: Average salons? **45%** and **39%**.

facts.fact: The page cites Kitomba's industry data saying regular clients make up about 40% of the typical client base but account for 70% of all appointments.
facts.unit: % of client base and % of appointments
facts.quote: regular clients make up about **40% of the typical client base** but account for **70% of all appointments**

facts.fact: Per Boulevard's Client Retention Report as cited on the page, clients who book their first appointment online return for a second visit 78% of the time, versus 39% for walk-ins.
facts.quote: clients who book their first appointment **online** return for a second visit **78% of the time**. Walk-ins return at just **39%**.

facts.fact: The page states that clients who request a specific stylist when booking online spend 30% more per visit than clients who request no one.
facts.quote: clients who request a specific stylist when booking online spend **30% more per visit**

facts.fact: The page states SMS open rates hit about 98% compared to about 20% for email.
facts.quote: SMS open rates hit about **98%** compared to email’s 20%

facts.fact: Research published in The Permanente Journal, as cited on the page, found text reminders improve appointment attendance by 14%.
facts.quote: text reminders improve appointment attendance by **14%**

facts.fact: Zenoti's consumer research, as cited on the page, found 81% of salon clients are more likely to rebook when they receive personalized messages.
facts.quote: **81% of salon clients** are more likely to rebook when they receive personalized messages.

facts.fact: The page's table lists an industry average first-time client retention of 35%.
facts.quote: | First-time client retention | 35% | 55%+ |

facts.fact: The page's table lists an industry average of 8-9 weeks between visits.
facts.quote: | Average weeks between visits | 8-9 weeks | 6-7 weeks |

facts.fact: The page's table lists an industry average no-show rate of 15-30%.
facts.quote: | No-show rate | 15-30% | Under 5% |

facts.fact: The page states that the author's own target is a rebooking rate of 70% or higher; this is the vendor's stated target, not a sourced benchmark.
facts.quote: | Rebooking rate | 40% | 70%+ |

facts.fact: The author's salon, located in Portland, has four chairs.
facts.quote: My salon isn’t the biggest in Portland. Four chairs, two full-time stylists, two part-time.

facts.fact: The author's salon employs two full-time stylists and two part-time stylists.
facts.quote: Four chairs, two full-time stylists, two part-time.

facts.fact: According to the author, the salon's book stays full six weeks out.
facts.quote: But our book stays full six weeks out.
